description: Primary income source. SSB PxWebApi v2 provides no table for income-component shares conditioned jointly on employment status and age group, and the no-synthetic-distributions rule (see CLAUDE.md) forbids inventing one. The Norwegian generator therefore DROPS this field (income_source_by_employment_age is empty), matching the Italian generator. No income_source is emitted for SSB personas, so there is nothing to normalise here.
